declared_before: any oracle was computed, any counterfactual submission was written and any score was read; the bars below are the ones the session brief set, restated verbatim here so the STOP decision is checkable against a pre-declared threshold
split: DEV-20 only; TEST-38 / test-49 / challenge not read, extracted or scored

premise_as_given.text: 66.1% of DEV misses (13,167 rows, oracle +3.85 GS-DetA) are confident detector boxes discarded by ByteTrack's Kalman-IoU rematch. W7's arms failed because they turned recovered boxes into NEW tracks, which the identity machinery names at 0.0%. The untested mechanism: ATTACH each discarded box to an EXISTING track, so it inherits the host's identity.
premise_as_given.verdict: MECHANISM CONFIRMED, VALUE REFUSED -- see stage1_findings

stage1_stop_rule.declared: if reachable value (attachable x host-named x realistic attach-precision) is below +0.75 GS-DetA on DEV-20, STOP after stage 1 and do not build an arm

stage2_bars_not_exercised.primary: >= +0.75 GS-DetA on DEV-20 over the SAME-STACK control with GS-HOTA not worse
stage2_bars_not_exercised.secondary: per-sequence paired helped > hurt, Wilcoxon p < 0.05, n = 20
stage2_bars_not_exercised.row_audit: attached-correct / attached-wrong-identity / attached-onto-GT-null, with wrong-identity < 25% of attached rows
stage2_bars_not_exercised.note: the best DEV-tuned rule PASSES the wrong-identity audit bar (291 of 1,780 rows = 16.3%) and FAILS the GS-DetA bar by 4.8x, which is why the audit bar alone would not have caught this arm

stage1_findings.reading: the mechanism works (attached rows are 65-68% attribute-correct, versus 0.0% attribute yield for the new tracks of v9-W7 A2) but the mass is small and GT-blind selection cannot find it: 58.4% of what ByteTrack discards is a duplicate or a phantom, and no geometry-only gate separates that from a real miss.

control_lineage.why: kb v9-w7-004: +1.02 GS-DetA drift between identical runs 8 days apart. Nothing was extracted this session, so every arm and its control come from ONE artifact set and the drift hazard is absent by construction.

instrument.discard_source: supervision.ByteTrack replayed over the cached conf=0.01 detector dump at DETECT_CONF 0.20 / min_hits 3 / lost_buffer 60, exactly as generator.extract drives it; validated by its kept-set GT recall of 0.9242 against the extraction's measured 0.9240 (kb v9-w7-005)
instrument.rejected_alternative: matching the detector dump against the control positions parquet by foot-point tolerance: the dump is a separate inference pass and a 2 px join leaves 22,210 of 225,926 positions rows unmatched, which would have misclassified 9.8% of KEPT boxes as discards and inflated the discard count from 24,418 to 46,989
instrument.gt_contact: measurement only. The counterfactual submissions copy attributes from our own tracks and project boxes with a homography fitted to our own rows; the oracle arms use GT solely to select which discard to attach and to which host, which is the quantity being bounded.

environment.cpu_only: laptop; no cluster slot was booked and no GPU was used
environment.scoring: eval.gsr_score.gs_hota, EVAL_CONFIGS['gs_hota_full'], both post-processing flag states (vote_track_attributes(role,team,jersey) + gk_side_repair(('team',)) ON and OFF) applied identically to control and arms
